<USER_REQUEST>
Implement the following three updates to the RentRide website using our existing Dark Navy (#0B1522), Teal (#149688), White (#FFFFFF), and Light Grey (#F4F6F9) design system (Poppins headings, Inter body text):

1. Update Header "More v" Dropdown Menu (Across All Pages):
- Make the "More v" pill button in the top navigation bar interactive (clickable/hoverable dropdown menu).
- Add links inside the dropdown menu pointing to:
  * "Trip Planner" -> pages/tripplanner.html
  * "Fare & Fuel Estimator" -> pages/calculate.html
  (Keep any other existing secondary links inside this dropdown neatly organized, and ensure relative paths work properly whether viewing index.html or pages inside the pages/ folder.)

2. Create Two New Standalone HTML Pages (Matching the Exact UI Layout):

A. File: pages/tripplanner.html (Title: Trip & Road-Trip Planner)
- Include the global Dark Navy header and footer.
- Hero Banner: Dark Navy background with bold white centered title "Road Trip Planner: Your Adventure Awaits".
- Interactive Route Map Card: Display an interactive/visual route map card at the top showing route pins, waypoints, zoom controls (+/-), and a route summary bar at the top-left of the map.
- Itinerary Builder Card (White card overlapping/below the map):
  * Heading: "Itinerary Builder"
  * Form row with "Start Date" and "End Date" date pickers (with live validation ensuring End Date is not before Start Date).
  * "Start Location" input with a "My Location" quick-fill pin button, and an "End Location" input.
  * "Stops" section: Dynamic list of route stops (e.g., scenic views, hotels, custom stops) with an "+ Add Custom Stop" input/button, distance input, and ability to reorder or remove stops.
  - Persistence: Save planned stops and itinerary details in `localStorage` so they persist on page reload.
  * Primary Teal full-width button: "Optimize Route" (calculates total route distance, estimated driving time, and displays an interactive itinerary summary).

B. File: pages/calculate.html (Title: Fare & Fuel
<truncated 16 bytes>
clude the global Dark Navy header and footer.
- Hero Banner: Dark Navy background with bold white centered title "Trip Cost Estimator".
- Main Calculator Card (White card with rounded corners):
  * "Vehicle Type" selector: Interactive selectable cards with car icons for "Sedan", "SUV", and "Van" (each with distinct daily rental rates and default MPG values).
  * "Trip Distance (miles)" numeric input with live validation (must be > 0).
  * "Start Date" and "End Date" date range inputs to calculate total rental days.
  * "Estimated Fuel Cost" row: Two side-by-side inputs for "Average MPG" (auto-updates when Vehicle Type changes, but editable) and "Current Gas Price ($/gallon)".
  * Primary Teal full-width button: "Calculate Estimated Cost".
- Live Results Breakdown Panel (Appears/updates below the button):
  * Displays calculated "Estimated Fuel: $XX.XX", "Estimated Rental: $XXX.XX", and bold "Total Estimated Cost: $XXX.XX".
  * Includes a subtle amber warning/note for dynamic seasonal pricing and a Teal link "Check current daily rates" linking to the fleet page.

3. Fix Car Images on Home Page (index.html):
- Currently, the featured/fleet car cards on index.html are showing the exact same car image for every vehicle.
- Replace the duplicate image URLs so that EVERY car card on index.html displays a distinct, high-resolution photo matching its specific vehicle model and category (e.g., a unique photo for the Sedan, a unique photo for the SUV, a unique photo for the Sports/Luxury car, and a unique photo for the Van/Hatchback). Ensure consistent aspect ratios (`object-fit: cover`) across all car cards.
